stats.notes: Confirmed the score wrap bug with a 3-token replay from a fresh game (seed 42): dash-down collects the coin (score 100), then right and right step onto the spikes at (3,3). Score goes 100 - 500 = -400 and displays as 65136 (a 16-bit wrap), and lives drop to 2. Design says score never goes below 0. Budget is nearly exhausted, so I am finishing here. Other areas (pause, dialogs, levers, gates, enemies, timer, completion) were not thoroughly tested.
